correctness.rationale: Exact orthant gamma moments produce the Gram blocks I, edge B=(1-s)^2I+s(1-s)R*R+s^2J, and coupling (s/sqrt(2))R*. The incidence identity RR*=(n-2)I+J splits them into one trivial eigenvector, n-1 copies of an explicit 2x2 block, and ker R of dimension n(n-3)/2. Direct eigenvalues exhaust (n-1)(n+2)/2 dimensions. Positive differences show unique T top; a negative determinant at e orders the remaining branches. The spectral theorem gives optimal sharp concentration and sharp gap; asymptotic estimates follow from exact polynomials. The actual standalone script independently reconstructed matrices for n=3..10, integrated the S2 octant by quadrature, and symbolically checked decisive identities. Finite checks are supportive, not all-dimensional proof.

originality.rationale: The inspected literature supplies general concentration matrices, numerical Slepian constructions, or results for hemispheres and global norms; none of the examined statements gives the dimension-uniform exact positive-orthant degree-two spectrum, the unique diagonal-zonal optimizer, the sharp gap, and its n-squared enhancement. value.rationale: The full dimension-uniform orthant spectrum is a natural complete classification for a non-axisymmetric Slepian region, including exact optimizer geometry, universal multiplicities, sharp stability, and a nontrivial n^2 enhancement relative to exponentially small orthant volume. This is stronger than a one-off small matrix computation and exposes a combinatorial Johnson incidence decomposition reusable for related symmetric polyhedral regions. No higher degree or general cone coverage is implied.
